:::{#sol-prac-exp-mle-oinf}

The observed information is:

$$
\ba
\oinf(\pmean; \vx)
&= -\hess(\pmean; \vx)
&& \text{(observed information is the negative Hessian)}
\\
&= -\paren{\frac{n}{\pmean^2} - \frac{2n\rvarbar}{\pmean^3}}
&& \text{(second derivative from the second-derivative exercise)}
\\
&= -\frac{n}{\pmean^2} + \frac{2n\rvarbar}{\pmean^3}
&& \text{(distribute the minus sign)}
\\
&= \frac{2n\rvarbar}{\pmean^3} - \frac{n}{\pmean^2}
&& \text{(reorder the terms)}
\ea
$$

:::
